Title: General availability: Apache log4J2 sink to Azure Data Explorer

Body.Content:
Azure Data Explorer(ADX/Kusto) now supports ingestion of data from log4j with the release of our new Log4J2 sink.

Log4j is a popular logging framework for Java applications maintained by the Apache Foundation. Log4j allows developers to control which log statements are output with arbitrary granularity based on the logger's name, logger level, and message pattern.

This sink allows you to easily stream your log data to Azure Data Explorer, where you can analyze, visualize, and alert on your logs in real time. With the Log4J2 sink, you can take advantage of ADX's powerful querying and ingestion capabilities to gain insights into your logs and detect issues before they become problems.

Check it out now and start streaming your logs today!

Learn more.
